name: Archive unloaded private agents with equivalent roots and finish teardown
detail: Seven byte-identical plists archived under task data; installed copies removed; task metadata and actual private tmux worker window removed; real treehouse return completed.

name: Leave shared, other-task, prefix-lookalike, escaping and malformed agents untouched
detail: All six outside-root plists and malformed plist remained byte-identical; no foreign archive was created.

name: Recover an absent task copy without retiring a missing nested lane
detail: Real launchctl confirmed two absent-copy private services unloaded; their plists were archived and task retired. A nested lane registered by a sibling clone, despite deleted directories, kept its exact plist and task record.

name: Refuse archive failure even when forced and retain recovery state
detail: Real mkdir failure caused explicit refusal with installed plist, task copy, task metadata, and private worker window preserved.

name: Generate ship and scout cleanup instructions with the configured parking verb
detail: The real scaffold CLI emitted matching private-service rules for all three ship modes and scouts under paused and awaiting, including status naming, literal bootout, and shared-daemon prohibition. The secondmate charter omitted this worker-only rule.
